QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Trade] Cubist Mercantilism
QuestInfo.0: The #p9390220# in Commerci Trade Center needs your help. There's been a typhoon!
QuestInfo.1: Set sail for voyage, but be careful! An angry kraken named Grosso Polpo has been spitting out obstacles on the sail route. #p9390220# suspects that it swallowed remains of a shipwreck...
QuestInfo.2: You brought back the wreckage to #p9390220#. She gave you a Mystical Cube as a reward.

0.1: Many ships were lost in the recent typhoon.
0.2: One of the ships that sank was carrying a valuable load of cubes. We need to recover our costs.
0.3: Can you collect some cubes for us? We will compensate you for your time. \r\n You may hunt Grosso Polpo to get the cubes while you travel to Rosa area and International Trader.

yes.0: Thank you. If you hunt some monsters in the Rosa area, you should have plenty of fragments before you know it.
yes.1: Bring them to me and I will reward you handsomely.

no.0: I understand. The place is very dangerous, after all.
no.1: If you ever change your mind, please let me know.

1.0: Great, I knew you wouldn't let me down.

yes.0: Cubes are plentiful among the monsters of the shipping lanes.
yes.1: I would appreciate it if you could bring them to me.

item.0: The best place to get fragments is from the kraken along the way to Rosa. Bring those to me.

mob.0: You should eliminate the kraken in the Rosa area.
